verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs confirm data is stored as local Markdown files by default and an explicit Export feature can export the entire graph in multiple open formats (Markdown, JSON, EDN, OPML, HTML, Roam JSON), giving switchers a clear exit path at any time. A community note flags a minor Markdown compatibility quirk (extra spaces vs Obsidian), which slightly tempers full portability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full-graph export working smoothly at scale, and confirmation that the new DB-based version preserves the same open-format export guarantees.
